title: Multiplex CRISPR genome regulation in mouse retina with hyper-efficient Cas12a
protocol: Identify promoter region of target gene on ENCODE.
Identify all canonical Cas12a PAMs in the promoter region.
Design crRNA between 20-23 bp for each target site.
Purchase crRNA as paired oligos.
Anneal crRNA oligos using standard protocol (95°C for 5min, then stepped down to room temperature).
Ligate annealed crRNA into pSLQ8453 plasmid digested with Esp3 enzyme in a ligation reaction at 24°C for 10 minutes.
Transform ligation reactions into Stellar competent cells.
Select colonies and verify by Sanger sequencing.
Culture mouse P19 cells in alpha-MEM with nucleosides (Invitrogen) with 10% FBS.
Seed P19 cells the day before transfection at 2x10^5 cells/mL for ~60-80% cell confluency at time of transfection.
Perform transient transfections with 3 µl of Mirus X2 transfection reagent per µg of total plasmid according to manufacturer protocols.
Treat transfected cells the day after transfection with 500 ug/ml hygromycin and 2 µg/ml puromycin for enrichment.
Collect cells at 48 hours post-selection (3 days post-transfection) for analysis.
Isolate RNA from transfected cells using Qiagen RNeasy Plus kit.
Reverse transcribe 100ng RNA per condition into cDNA using iScript kit.
Perform quantitative real-time PCR with SYBR master mix according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Quantify RNA expression by ΔΔCt, normalizing based on glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate dehydrogenase expression.
Seed transfected P19 cells into black flat-bottom 96-well plates.
Maintain cells in dual-antibiotic selection media.
Aspirate out the media from the wells.
Fix cells with 4% formaldehyde in 1x PBS for 15 minutes.
Aspirate out the formaldehyde solution.
Permeabilize cells with 0.25% Triton X-100 in 1x DPBS for 5 minutes.
Apply blocking solution (5% donkey serum in DPBS) and incubate for 0.5-1 hour.
Incubate plate at 4°C overnight after wrapping in aluminum foil.
Wash each well three times with 1x DBPS.
Apply secondary antibody Alexa Fluor-conjugated diluted in blocking solution.
Wash each well three times with 1x PBS.
Keep cells in 1x PBS for imaging.
Combine the U6-crRNA array and CAG-dCas12a-miniVPR into a single plasmid using NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly.
Use pregnant CD1 mice for in vivo electroporation experiments, maintaining them under standard conditions until birth.
Electroporate neonatal mice at post-natal day 0-3.
Mix crRNA-array-dCas12a plasmid (e.g., pSLQ10873) with CAG-GFP plasmid (pSLQ10301) at a ratio of approximately 5:1.
Maintain the total concentration of DNA solution at 2 µg/µl.
Incubate newborn mice on ice to anesthetize them briefly.
Carefully incise the eyelids open with a sharp 30-gauge needle.
Inject 0.3 - 0.5 μl of DNA solution (containing 0.1% FastGreen dye) into the subretinal space as an injection tracer.
Place the head of the injected pup between a 10mm diameter tweezer electrode.
Apply 5 pulses of 80V, each lasting 50ms with intervals of 950ms.
Euthanize animals at the desired timepoint.
Dissect out the electroporated eye and fix it in 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 1x PBS (pH 7.4) for 2 hours at room temperature.
Incubate dissected retina in a series of sucrose solutions at room temperature:
First, in 5% sucrose in 1X PBS for 5 minutes; then in 15% sucrose in 1X PBS for 15 minutes; next in 30% sucrose in 1X PBS for 1 hour.
Mix OCT and 30% sucrose in PBS (1:1) solution, incubate at 4°C overnight.
Freeze and store the prepared retina sample at -80°C.
Prepare 20 μm cryosections using a Leica CM3050S cryostat.
Place the sections onto Superfrost microscope slides.
Wash the slides briefly in 1X PBS.
Incubate the slides in 0.5% Triton in 1X PBS for 20 min.
Block the slides for 30 min in a solution of 0.1% Triton, 1% bovine serum albumin and 10% donkey serum in 1X PBS.
Incubate the slides overnight with primary antibodies diluted in blocking solution at 4°C.
Wash the slides three times in 0.1% Triton in 1X PBS.
Incubate the slides for 1-2 hr in secondary antibodies and DAPI.
Wash the slides three times with 0.1% Triton in 1X PBS.
Mount the slides with Fluoromount-G.
Image the slides using an LSM 710 or LSM 880 Confocal inverted laser scanning microscope.
Use a Plan Apochromat objective with lasers at 405, 488, 561 and 633 nm.
